questions.why: Після *seem* — прикметник (як після *be*): *She seems happy.*

questions.q: It seems that she lives in Bonn. = She seems ___ in Bonn.
questions.why: Present Simple → простий інфінітив: *She seems to live in Bonn.*

questions.q: It seems that she has lived in Bonn. = She seems ___ in Bonn.
questions.why: Present Perfect → перфектний інфінітив: *to have lived*.

questions.q: It seems that she is living in Bonn. = She seems ___ in Bonn.
questions.why: Present Continuous → тривалий інфінітив: *to be living*.

questions.q: It seems that she was living in Bonn. = She seems ___ in Bonn.
questions.why: Past Continuous → *to have been living*.
Загальне вміння (взагалі гарно співає) — простий інфінітив *to sing*.
Саме зараз — тривалий інфінітив *to be singing*.
Минуле (*yesterday*) — *to have sung*.

answer: It seems that she lives in Bonn
questions.why: *It seems that* + повне речення з підметом і дієсловом.

questions.q: It seems ___ me that he's lying.
questions.why: *It seems to me that…* — мені здається.
*doesn't seem to understand* — заперечення через *doesn't*.
Уже забули — *to have forgotten*.

questions.q: There ___ to be a mistake in the bill.
questions.why: *There seems to be* — здається, є (*appears* — синонім).
*seem like* + іменник: *He seems like a nice guy.* (Британці кажуть і *seems a nice guy*.)

questions.q: It ___ that the shop is closed.
questions.why: *It seems that…* — без *-ing* і без *to*.
Процес зараз — *to be working*.

questions.q: He'll probably get the job. = He seems ___ the job.
questions.why: Ймовірне майбутнє — *seems likely to get*.

answer: She seems to be very busy
questions.why: *seems to be very busy* — з прикметником потрібне *to be*.

answer: It seems to me that he is right
questions.why: *It seems to me that…* — мені здається.
questions.hint: Мені здається, що він має рацію.

questions.why: *seem to have left* — дія вже відбулася.
*can't seem to* + дієслово — «ніяк не можу».

questions.q: You ___ tired. Did you sleep badly?
questions.why: Про зовнішній вигляд — *look* + прикметник: *You look tired.*

questions.q: There seem ___ be some mistakes in the text.
questions.why: *There seem to be* + множина (*mistakes*).
